title: Concentrix Helps Clients Fight Fraud, Manage Risk, and Build Trust in the AI Era, Earning Everest Group Recognition Across Four Business-Critical Areas
summary: Reports highlight Concentrix' growing leadership in driving meaningful client outcomes across AI operations, compliance, and digital trust
body_markdown:
## Reports highlight Concentrix’ growing leadership in driving meaningful client outcomes across AI operations, compliance, and digital trust


**NEWARK, Calif.** (October 29, 2026) –[Concentrix Corporation](https://www.concentrix.com/news/) (NASDAQ:[CNXC](https://ir.concentrix.com/) ), a global technology and services leader, announced today it has earned designations from Everest Group across four areas critical to modern business operations: fraud management, financial crime and compliance, trust and safety, and agentic operations. Together, these designations highlight the evolving needs of Concentrix’ clients and the innovative solutions being developed alongside them to address emerging risks, regulatory pressures, and new opportunities with AI.


**Concentrix was positioned as a Leader in Everest Group’s inaugural 2026 Fraud Management Operations Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment** and achieved the highest designation in market impact among 20 providers evaluated. Fraud is becoming more sophisticated as real-time payments accelerate and AI lowers the barriers to increasingly complex attacks. In this environment, businesses need new ways to strengthen resilience while improving how fraud is identified and addressed. Everest Group highlighted Concentrix’ ability to bring together advanced technology, strategic partnerships, and operational expertise to help clients stay ahead of evolving threats.


This assessment follows Concentrix’ acquisition of CastleHill Managed Risk Solutions, which expanded the company’s capabilities across governance, risk, compliance, third-party risk management, and AI governance. By combining these capabilities with its global scale and deep operational knowledge, Concentrix helps organizations build trust, adapt more quickly to change, and manage risk in ways that support long-term business growth.


“Organizations today are facing a fundamentally different operating environment, in which AI is creating enormous opportunity while simultaneously introducing new risks, complexity, and expectations,” said Axel Mouquet, Senior Vice President of Global Practices, Concentrix. “Our clients are at the forefront of this shift, challenging us to think differently, move faster, and solve challenges that are redefining how businesses operate. These recognitions reflect our belief that the future belongs to organizations that can bring together humans, AI, and operations in practical ways that build trust and deliver results. We’re proud to be the partner that helps clients navigate that future.”


**Concentrix was also named a Leader in Everest Group’s 2026 Trust and Safety Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment** , marking its sixth consecutive year in the Leaders category. As AI-generated content, platform abuse, and regulatory scrutiny reshape digital ecosystems, trust and safety has become a board-level priority. The Leader designation reflects Concentrix’ ability to blend specialized expertise, AI-enabled operations, and platform knowledge to support safer digital experiences at scale.


**In addition, Everest Group named Concentrix a Star Performer in its 2026 Financial Crime and Compliance Operations Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment and a Major Contender in its 2026 Banking and Financial Services Agentic Operations PEAK Matrix® Assessment.** Together, these distinctions reflect continued investment in the future of regulated operations, where AI, compliance, risk management, and intelligent automation are becoming increasingly interconnected.


Visit the company’s website for[more information on Concentrix’ Financial Crime and Compliance services](https://www.concentrix.com/services-solutions/financial-crimes-compliance/) and[Trust & Safety solutions](https://www.concentrix.com/services-solutions/trust-safety/) .
